game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing, a cracking glacier: the mountaineer must hold off yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phrase Slicer: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing: a cracking glacier
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Crossing, repeat each round: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces. Then check phrase_ok and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from yetis in Glacier Crossing: keep phrase_ok above zero until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Phrase Slicer
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 2, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

Survive for 46 seconds to complete the level.
